d: The European Union has finally been invited to attend Russia-Ukraine peace negotiations. US special envoy Jared Kushner says that both Moscow and Kyiv have agreed to expand the peace talks to include Brussels, after the trilateral between the US, Russia, Ukraine in Abu Dhabi. EU Foreign Policy Chief, Kaja Kallas, is likely to represent Brussels at the next talks. Meanwhile, Nvidia’s reported leadership turmoil has sparked a Silicon Valley campaign to bring Jensen Huang back, with Elon Musk and other influential figures reportedly backing his return.
